title: $L_1$ Actions and Embeddings of Property A Spaces
summary: We provide several new characterizations of Property A for bounded degree graphs. In particular, we show that $(X,d)$ has Property A if and only if there is a proper gauge $ω$ such that the Lipschitz free space $\operatorname{LF}(X,ω\circ d)$ is isomorphic to $\ell_1$. As a consequence, all finitely generated groups with Property A admit proper uniformly Lipschitz affine actions on $\ell_1$. Moreover, for groups with finite Nagata dimension, we obtain actions with compression exponent 1. This result applies to higher rank lattices, such as $\operatorname{SL}(3,\mathbb{Z})$.
